subject: Post-call: route add, monthly volume bands & target $/1M
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@edgepay.com>, Priya Singh <priya@edgepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-05T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps: route add and volume bands

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can model a few pricing scenarios and draft a renewal/expansion proposal: 

1) Volume expectation (per month): you mentioned a steady-state band plus seasonal peaks. Please confirm approximate ranges for the next 12 months (low / expected / high).
2) Routes/models to add: you said you want to add an OCR route and a Summarization route (both high-context). Any estimate for tokens/reqs per route?
3) Target $/1M tokens: helpful if you can provide a budget range or target effective price (e.g. $/1M tokens) you’d like us to aim for when we propose blended options.
4) Timing & commitment: are you aiming to sign an amendment in the next 30–45 days for a Jan 1 start?

Attached is a blank pricing worksheet (edgepay-pricing-worksheet.xlsx) — if you can populate the monthly bands that’s ideal; otherwise a quick note in reply is fine.

Planned next steps from our side: Ben will run a couple of blended-rate scenarios (hosted vs dedicated/reserved), I’ll assemble a short mutual action plan, and we’ll aim to get you a first-pass pricing view by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Sofia

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the recap. Quick answers below (happy to sync if helpful):

1) Monthly volume (tokens): low ~8M, expected ~11M, high ~18M. We see steady growth quarter to quarter; Q4 is peak.
2) Routes: OCR (high token per request, batch processing), Summarization (shorter outputs but many calls). We estimate OCR will be ~60% of new route volume, Summarization ~40% in month 1.
3) Target price: our procurement target is roughly $800–$950 / 1M tokens effective blended. We know that different routes have different cost implications so blended is fine.
4) Timing: yes — target Jan 1 start for expanded routes. We need commercial terms sorted by mid-December for internal approvals.

I filled in a quick sketch in the worksheet (attached as "edgepay-pricing-worksheet.xlsx"). Let me know if you need any more granularity.

— Alex

Date: 2027-11-05T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: route add and volume bands — preliminary scenarios

Alex — thanks for the worksheet and ranges. I modeled three quick scenarios (high-level):

- Scenario A (hosted, no commit): list pricing, estimated effective $/1M at expected volume (11M/mo): ~$1,150 / 1M. Rapid scale but higher unit cost.
- Scenario B (blended reserved + hosted mix): commit to 9–12M/mo for 12 months, add OCR + Summarization as separate routes but folded into a blended invoice. Effective blended rate: ~$925 / 1M at 11M/mo; $850 / 1M at 13M/mo.
- Scenario C (dedicated reserved pool): 12M/month committed, priority capacity and quantization profile tuned for OCR — effective ~ $700–$760 / 1M. This requires a contract amendment and minimum commit term.

Notes/assumptions: OCR is heavier on GPU cycles (we assume 2.6x cost vs summarization). Blended math in the worksheet includes that weight. I attached the worked workbook and a short note on assumptions.

Attachments: edgepay-pricing-worksheet.xlsx (worked workbook)

Operational next steps I recommend:
1) Pricing workshop (30–45 min) between EdgePay engineering + Redwood solutions to validate route tokenization and per-request weightings.
2) If EdgePay is comfortable with committed baseline, we can draft an amendment with step-up bands and blended invoice examples.
3) Legal/commercial review in parallel — Marissa, can you draft an amendment template we can reuse?

I can run a more granular per-route forecast after the workshop. If you want, we can also swap some of the reserved capacity for burstable host to reduce commit size.

— Ben

Subject: Internal: EdgePay follow-up — ask & next steps

Quick internal note following Alex's reply and Ben's scenarios: 

1) Alex's target band is $800–$950 / 1M. Ben's Scenario B at ~$925 looks like the in-range ask; Scenario C could be our competitive play for committed 12M/mo.
2) Action: Marissa — please draft a short amendment (1–2 pages) that includes:
   - committed baseline 12M/mo with step-up discounts at 15M and 20M
   - blended invoicing across routes with a clear per-route weighting appendix
   - a 60-day review clause for usage reconciliation
   - proposed SLA bump if they commit to dedicated capacity
3) Approvals: I’d like permission to offer a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to ~1 month at the blended rate) and up to 15% commercial discount off list for a 12M/mo 12-month commit. Ben — confirm that 15% is within allowable margin for a reserved offer; if not, flag the maximum concession you can approve.
4) Schedule: Pricing workshop with EdgePay engineers — target next Tue or Wed (Nov 9/10). Ben, please propose two 30–45 min slots.

I'll hold until Marissa shares the draft amendment and Ben confirms discount flexibility. Thanks team.

Sofia
